assertions.assertion: Agent should not make any changes.
assertions.rationale: The agent did not execute any reservation modification tools. Despite the customer's initial requests for flights, cabin upgrades, and baggage additions, and after presenting options and pricing, the customer ultimately declined due to budget constraints. The agent respected this in message [14], confirming the reservation HXDUBJ remains unchanged with no tool calls to modify it.

summary: Agent correctly made no changes to the reservation after the customer cancelled the request due to cost.
